description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeSkillDao class, which manages database operations related to employee skills within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching employee skills, as well as handling allowed skills for employees using Doctrine ORM with complex queries and pagination.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling EmployeeSkill entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and complex queries with pagination.

methods.name: saveEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeSkill entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeSkillById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeSkill entity based on employee number and skill ID.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeSkills
methods.description: Deletes multiple EmployeeSkill records for a specific employee based on skill IDs.

methods.name: searchEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Searches for EmployeeSkill records matching specified filter parameters, returning a list of entities.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeSkillsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of EmployeeSkill records matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeAllowedSkills
methods.description: Retrieves skills that are allowed for an employee, excluding those already assigned.

methods.name: getEmployeeAllowedSkillsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of skills allowed for an employee, based on filter parameters.
